annotation.title_clean: Presidente Luis Abinader encabeza lanzamiento de Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: President Luis Abinader leads launch of National Artificial Intelligence Strategy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de la Presidencia de la República Dominicana (MINPRE)
annotation.summary_en: Dominican Republic government press release on the October 2023 launch of its National AI Strategy (ENIA), led by President Abinader. It stresses economic growth, public services, talent and data hubs (Latam 4.0), BCIE funding, and a proposed international treaty banning AI as a weapon of war. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Launch of the National AI Strategy (ENIA), first in Central America and the Caribbean
Government supports an international treaty prohibiting AI use as a weapon of war
MoU creating Latam 4.0 coalition, talent hub #YoSoyFuturoRD and a data hub
BCIE approved funds for the AI strategy
ENIA aims to shift toward a knowledge-based economy with AI training
